protocol.primary: Fit one fixed-weight model on all source patients with outcome and source duration >= landmark; evaluate all target patients with outcome and target duration >= the same landmark.
protocol.matched_72h: Fit on source patients with outcome and source duration >=72 h; evaluate target patients with outcome and target duration >=72 h. At 72 h training is identical to primary.
protocol.fixed_24_to_72_rule: Train independent fixed landmark models at 24 and 72 h on the source primary cohort; compare their target predictions in the target complete-72h cohort.
